Summary Table

Source: R/cea.R
table_summary.Rd

Returns a statistical summary table of the CEA results, detailing incremental costs, incremental QALYs, and the ICER.

Example Output:

Cost-effectiveness analysis summary

Reference intervention: Strategy 1
Comparator intervention: Strategy 2

Optimal decision: Strategy 2

                 Strategy 1  Strategy 2
Expected Costs   15000       18000
Expected QALYs   12.5        13.1

ICER: 5000 / QALY

Usage

table_summary(study)

Arguments

study

A hermes_cea object
